gloss: to cut in; to interrupt; to butt in

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {割|わ}り{込|こ}みませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {割|わ}り{込|こ}んでいなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {割|わ}り{込|こ}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to cut in line; to push in
definitions.explanation: To force one's way into a line or queue, bypassing others who were waiting.

definitions.gloss: to cut in (while driving); to merge aggressively
definitions.explanation: To suddenly move one's vehicle into traffic or another lane, often in a rude or dangerous manner.
To interject during a conversation or activity, often in an unwelcome manner.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). The person or vehicle cutting in is the subject; the line, lane, or conversation being intruded on is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧Y⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{割|わ}り{込|こ}む.

PASSIVE: Because the action is unwelcome, the passive {割|わ}り{込|こ}まれる is very common — it presents the speaker as the injured party (⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{割|わ}り{込|こ}まれた, 'someone cut in on me').

ASPECT: 〜⟦てくる→来る：00254_kuru⟧ is the usual form when the intrusion moves toward the speaker ({割|わ}り{込|こ}んでくる). ている describes a state of currently being cut in on and is comparatively rare.

FORMATION:
Compound verb: ⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧ (to divide, split) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). The 〜{込|こ}む pattern emphasizes forcing or pushing into something.

COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{割|わ}り{込|こ}む - to cut in line
・⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{割|わ}り{込|こ}む - to cut into a lane
・⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{割|わ}り{込|こ}む - to butt into a conversation

REGISTER:
Almost always negative, implying rudeness or lack of consideration for others. There is no neutral way to describe your own {割|わ}り{込|こ}む; when you must interrupt politely, soften it with ⟦すみません→すみません：00998_sumimasen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ as in example 3.
